prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied BLANCO / NAMI RS sprite atlas. Return ONLY the complete UPPER REAR VIEW white Japanese convertible, on a transparent background; no portraits. Same detailed crisp hand-painted HD-2D pixel style, same upper-left warm sunlight.
CRITICAL GEOMETRY REPAIR: the input has an anatomy/perspective error — it shows TWO wheel surfaces on EACH side, like four tires, with a long thin white fender blade dividing each pair. This is WRONG. Replace that whole wheel-and-adjacent-fender arrangement with exactly TWO visible REAR TIRES TOTAL: one coherent continuous rear tire under the LEFT rear wheel arch, and one coherent continuous rear tire under the RIGHT rear wheel arch. Exactly TWO ground-contact patches. NO extra forward/front tires outside either fender. NO paired/double/tandem wheels. NO long narrow white fender blade splitting a tire. Redraw the adjacent white rear wheel arches naturally so each arch partially covers the upper portion of its ONE rear tire. We view the car directly from behind: both wheel planes parallel to the longitudinal axis, zero toe, minimal camber. The rear-facing tread is broad, vertically oriented with subtle tire grooves and rounded shoulders; virtually no visible metal spoke/rim face. Both tire centerlines upright and parallel. Two rear tires, not four. Front wheels must be completely hidden behind the body from this straight rear view.
Keep the original overall car width, body height, axle track and bottom ground-contact height; the two rear tires should occupy the normal LEFT and RIGHT rear tire positions beneath the bumper, each of realistic single-tire width. Remove the erroneous outside duplicate wheels rather than retaining or disguising them as rubber strips. Draw a plausible sidewall/quarter-panel silhouette where the erroneous extra wheels were. Wheel-adjacent white fender geometry MAY and SHOULD change to fix the bad occlusion. Do not preserve the defective double-wheel silhouette.
Everything ABOVE the wheel regions remains exactly consistent with the source: same turquoise-shirt short-haired man driving on the left, same long-black-haired woman in a white blouse at right, hair/pose/black seats, mirrors, rear deck, white bumper panel, paired round taillights, third brake lamp, plate, single right exhaust. Do not redesign the upper body or change identities. Keep the complete car visible, centered, straight and level, matching original rear framing and game-sprite proportions. No banking, no turning, no camber stance, no speed blur, no ground plane, no opaque background, no extra people/text/logos.
Inspect final geometry before finishing: COUNT exactly TWO visible rubber tire bodies and TWO road-contact patches; each tire is a continuous shape with no white vertical blade or duplicate circle dividing it. Repaint actual wheel perspective and overlapping white fenders, not a stretch/shear of the old wheels.
